meta.title: Transboundary haze risk index
meta.description: Monthly risk indicator for haze reaching Singapore and Kuala Lumpur, from harmonized fire activity in Sumatra and Kalimantan. Not a forecast.
meta.formula: exposure = (Sumatra count x 1.0 + Kalimantan count x 0.6) x monsoon weight; index = percentile of exposure among all months of 2003-2025

source_codes.model: MODIS-based estimate in VIIRS-equivalent units (harmonization model)
source_codes.nrt: VIIRS near real time, not passed through the model

sources: NASA FIRMS MODIS C6.1 and VIIRS 375 m active fire detections
meta.series_columns: arrays aligned by position: year, month, source, counts, scopes
